attBesluta.text: Purchased this table to serve as a grill prepping station for my guy. I specifically picked it for the open space underneath because it would be placed under our patio, up against the house, where we would still need to be able to get to an electrical outlet. I also liked the height. The measurements were a bit off so it doesn't fit in the space perfectly but it serves the purpose and has been a good addition to our outdoor space. It's pretty sturdy and was easy to assemble. Would recommend.
